We revised the final section of the introduction to provide a more explicit critique of existing
studies. This includes clearer identification of unresolved gaps in previous research,
particularly the limited number of cross-regional comparative studies between Southeast
Asia and the Middle East and the lack of connections between global inclusive education
frameworks and everyday implementation practices in non-Western contexts.
